name: Retail & E-commerce
description: Omnichannel commerce, inventory, pricing, promotions, and customer 360
rules: Stock quantities must reconcile across warehouse, store, and online within SLA
Price and promo changes are effective-dated; never overwrite historical prices
Order/fulfillment events are append-only until terminal state
PII in customer profiles masked outside production analytics zones
memories: Black Friday / Singles Day traffic spikes require pre-warmed clusters
Returns reverse-ETL must not double-count revenue in gold marts
